thread:
Maya Patel: Announcement: Nora Elbaz is joining Redwood Inference as Head of Developer Experience, starting 2025-05-05. She will run DevEx (SDKs, docs, quickstarts) and report to the CTO. We'll also have an interim PMIC for the docs backlog: Diego Morales will act as interim Docs Lead for the next 8 weeks while we onboard Nora.

Nora Elbaz: Really excited to join! I'll be scheduling skip-levels and listening sessions in week one. Looking forward to meeting product and eng leads.

Diego Morales: Happy to cover docs handoff. I'll freeze non-critical doc churn for 2 weeks and prioritize high-impact quickstarts.

Leah Kim: Recruiting note: we have approval to post two new IC roles under DevEx: Senior Technical Writer and SDK Engineer. I'll share reqs and interviewer rubrics tomorrow.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel added event "Nora intro + listening session" to calendar Mon 11:00-11:30 6 attendees: all@company

Samira Ahmed: Heads-up to folks owning oncall docs 5 update runbooks and links to the new docs repo path by EOD Fri so Diego has a clean handoff.

Alex Gomez: Quick question: any change to internal contribution policy for docs? We had quarterly freezes for major rewrites.

Maya Patel: No policy change right now. Nora will review contribution flow and suggest process improvements. If teams need exceptions during the transition, ping me.

Nora Elbaz: For the listening sessions, please bring one example of a docs gap you hit in the last month and any PR process pain points.

Diego Morales: I'll coordinate with eng leads to create a short list of priority quickstarts to unblock early users.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Welcome Nora! We'll open a hiring thread for the two IC roles; Leah will tag the hiring panel.
